plugins.name: zapad-house-rules
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic behavioral guidelines injected at every session start: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution. Sits on top of every other Zapad skill/stack.

plugins.name: zapad-js-stack
plugins.description: The canonical Zapad TypeScript web stack: TanStack Start on AWS serverless (Lambda), Prisma + Postgres, Better Auth, MUI. Defaults and invariants for scaffolding and architecture decisions.

plugins.name: zapad-laravel-backend
plugins.description: Zapad's canonical Laravel backend architecture: single-action controllers, an Actions layer, Form Requests, domain exceptions, and Pest testing conventions. Covers project structure, coding guidelines, the new-feature workflow, testing, and conformance review of existing codebases.

plugins.name: zapad-design-flow
plugins.description: The git and project workflow for designers, in Portuguese: set up the machine, create and run high-fidelity prototypes in Vite + React + Tailwind, and the full branch, commit, Pull Request and rescue cycle, with guards for people who do not know git.
